name: Resolution of singularities and log principalization in characteristic zero
scope: Analytic resolution by smooth-center blowups, isomorphism over the regular locus, with simple normal crossings exceptional divisor; sequences finite over relatively compact subsets. Mark-one principalization on a smooth analytic manifold: centers in the current zero set, controlled transform obtained by dividing by exactly one exceptional factor, final unit ideal and simple normal crossings accumulated boundary. Compact inputs give finite sequences.
justification: Explicit author exception for long established results such as resolution.

name: Fornæss–Narasimhan disc criterion on reduced complex spaces
scope: An upper semicontinuous function u:X→[-∞,+∞) is locally an ambient psh restriction, allowing identically −∞ components, if and only if every holomorphic disc pullback is subharmonic or identically −∞. No other Levi-problem or Stein theorem is proposed as an implicit interface.
justification: The complete original proof imports substantial Stein-space results, including Siu Stein neighborhoods. A precise approval question is pending; elapsed time is not approval.
